meta.description: The ORVIBO AI Video Intercom System joins face-recognition door stations, MixPad panels in every home and the property management platform: keyless entry, notices, security and smart home control for residential developments.
banner.bannerDesc: The video intercom, reinvented: a must for flagship developments
banner.investorWrapper: Strategic smart home supplier to Evergrande, Midea Real Estate, CIFI, Shimao and Kaisa
sec1.title: Digital infrastructure: the edge of tomorrow's real estate
sec1.desc: New digital infrastructure, a direction the state has repeatedly made a priority, is set to drive homes and communities toward smart living. AI systems cut staffing, operating and management costs, add depth and value to every development and help developers stand out in a fiercely competitive market.
sec1.card: AI video monitoring for the community
sec1.card2: Residents can view the community's open spaces with the Video monitoring button. When someone isn't following safety measures, property management is alerted right away, before problems start.
sec1.card4: Face recognition knows which floor you live on and sends the elevator there, so you never have to press the button.
sec1.card6: When residents drive up to the gate, their license plate is recognized and the barrier lifts at once. Once they're through, the elevator in their building is called for them: home sooner, with no fuss.
alt.sec1_1: The AI camera spotted someone without a mask and alerted property management
sec2.title: The trouble with traditional video intercoms
sec2.card2: Intercom, smart switches, AC panel: the wall by the show flat's door looks cluttered, which drags the whole project down.
sec2.card4: The video intercom only opens the door remotely, a long way from a smart development.
sec2.card6: Traditional developments ignore residents when they digitize and automate management: even basic notices are paper sheets taped up in the elevator.
sec3.title: The video intercom, reinvented: a must for flagship developments
sec3.desc: It connects the smart home and the smart community in every scenario, for more comfortable living and more efficient property management and services.
sec3.card: Distributed AI hub for the community
sec3.card2: The smart terminal in every home is the hub of the smart home and also connects to the smart community system, so the two work together.
sec3.card4: One app with scenes runs lighting, shading, security, HVAC and music throughout the home, along with face-recognition door stations and indoor AI video intercoms.
sec3.card5: A platform for home and community
sec3.card6: The management's information platform posts notices, events, lost and found and disinfection rounds on time, bringing residents and management closer and raising satisfaction and loyalty.
sec4.title: A distributed AI hub for the community
sec4.desc: Backed by powerful AI and cloud computing, it is the hub of the smart community, joining home and community and truly connecting people, devices and services.
alt.sec4: The panel at home runs lighting, climate, security, shading and media.
sec5.title: Tech aesthetics with a Red Dot award
sec5.desc: The AI video intercom system was created by an iF Gold Award-winning design team and won a 2020 Red Dot award. It carries on the firm lines and minimalist order of the MixPad family, lifts the look of building and home alike and gives technology warmth.
sec6.title: A new standard for video intercoms
sec6.cardDesc4: Calls the elevator in one tap as you leave
sec6.cardDesc5: Property notices pushed to the panel
sec6.cardDesc6: Water, power, gas and service fee bills

sec8.title: Unlock from anywhere indoors
sec8.desc: The AI video intercom system moves past the single mechanical unlock button of traditional intercoms and rethinks control at every distance, for convenient, natural access.
alt.sec8: One-tap unlock, near the door: a touch key opens the door in one tap, simple and convenient. Unlock from any MixPad, farther from the door: answer the intercom on another MixPad, even in the bedroom, without walking to the door to unlock it.
sec9.title: Smart living that thinks of everything
sec9.desc: The AI video intercom also runs custom scenes that control several appliances at once: leaving, coming home, dinner or movie night all start with your voice or one tap on the panel.
sec9.card2: In the morning the curtains open on schedule and the lights come on: a gentle wake-up for a day full of energy.
sec9.card4: The AC sets a comfortable temperature and humidity and soothing music starts. A day at home, with exercise to relax body and mind.
sec9.card6: Afternoon reading: adjust the curtains and the lights by voice. A comfortable reading spot to recharge at home.
sec9.card8: Turn on movie mode: the projector screen comes down, the speakers switch on and the curtains slowly close. A visual feast at home.
sec10.title: Connects to hundreds of appliances
sec10.desc: A single MixPad E connects hundreds of smart devices, from switches, lights, AC and curtains to speakers, sensors and drying racks, and controls them all from one place.
alt.sec10: Connected appliances: TV, rice cooker, bread maker, electric drying rack, water dispenser, fridge, dryer, electric oven, lights, robot vacuum, water heater, washing machine, air conditioner, air purifier, dishwasher, air cooler, electric fan, fan heater.
sec11.title: A management platform for home and community
sec11.item_info2: Unlock at the door station and the elevator comes down to the ground floor; MixPad calls it to your floor in one tap.
sec11.item_info4: When the community is disinfected, the system reminds residents to close their windows to keep the spray out.
sec11.item_info6: Face recognition keeps small children from going out alone, and they can go down to play without a card or key.
sec12.title: Secure, efficient access
sec12.desc1: AI face recognition opens the door fast, with no effort at all. Face, password, IC card, visitor code or QR code: with top performance, residents get in faster and with more peace of mind.
sec12.safer2: Dual HD cameras with liveness detection.
sec12.faster1: Senses you and opens as you arrive.
sec12.easier1: 1080p camera with up to 105 dB WDR, clear in bright light and backlight.
sec12.easier2: Precise light sensor with automatic fill light.
sec12.stronger1: The industry's largest face library, for communities of up to 50,000 people.
sec12.desc2: The smart villa door station handles visitor calls, video intercom, remote unlocking, key cards and more: when someone arrives, you let them in from indoors without walking to the gate.

sec13.title: All-round community security
sec13.desc: The ORVIBO smart security system covers every scenario with community alarms plus in-home security alarms, guarding the whole community.
alt.sec13: The ORVIBO smart security system. Community security: door-open alarm, forced-door alarm, door station tamper alarm, blacklist alarm, fire alarm. Home security: 8 wired security zones, wireless security sensors, alarms that call the owner and alert management, one-tap arming and disarming, locally or remotely.
sec14.title: Services that come home
sec14.desc: A panel in every home takes services straight to residents and makes the most of them.

sec19.title: More products and support to choose from
sec19.sec2: Building on the traditional video intercom, a cloud platform brings HD audio and video calls between the community entrance and residents' phones, with remote door opening.
sec19.sec4: A PC client, a large display and one-card access put the whole community under one management.
sec19.sec6: Perimeter protection and home intrusion alarms detect intruders precisely and, over IoT, alert the property management in real time to keep the community safe.
